data.name: Williams 82
data.description: Williams 82 was derived from backcrossing a phytophthora root rot resistance locus from the donor parent Kingwa into the recurrent parent Williams. A sub-line, Wm82-ISU-01, was derived by Robert Stupar (University of Minnesota) by inbreeding original W82 seed. That sub-line, registered as PI 704477, was used for assembly Wm82.gnm6 / Wm82.a6.
